identityFingerprint: SHA-256 length-prefixed UTF-8 fields: dossier-v1, workflowId, initializationId, applicantId
prepareFingerprint: SHA-256 length-prefixed UTF-8 fields: dossier-v1, workflowId, initializationId, applicantId, stepId, fingerprint, sourceVersion, sorted credentialIds
finalization: all business commit receipts, then all completion acknowledgments, durable coordinator SUCCEEDED, then release notifications; retry release after success, never compensate
recovery: coordinator replays durable decisions; never age-based participant rollback

deadlineAt.description: Immutable UTC deadline; new workflows must expire within 30 seconds

controlApi.publisherIdentity: message-broker is reserved; no external caller token

credentialBoundary.snapshot: Must durably select exclusive DOSSIER_V1 generation ownership and return facts.generationPath=DOSSIER_V1; reject any prior legacy generation/documents/workers/outbox for this initialization.
credentialBoundary.prepare: identity, reliable sourceVersion, inputs containing the agreed Applicant/Record snapshots, persisted asOf. Fingerprint the full request and persist replay-stable credentialIds/provenance intent before real database preparation.
credentialBoundary.preparedReceipt: Includes 1..32 distinct nonzero credentialIds, retrievable from durable control intent after reply loss; prepared document rows are not ordinary committed data.
credentialBoundary.completion: No independent legacy CredentialsReady callbacks for dossier rows; acknowledge/release is coordinator-controlled. Persist notification intent with local changes.
